name: Barbed Net
useText: Throw 15 ft, Dex save or Restrained; escape hurts
description: A net woven with steel hooks. Every struggle bites.
rules: As a Net: replace one attack, target within 15 ft makes a Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) or is Restrained. Escape: action, DC 10 Str (Athletics). Each failed escape check deals 1d4 Piercing damage. Net has AC 10, 5 HP. Huge or larger succeed automatically.

name: Reinforced Net
useText: Throw 15 ft, Dex save or Restrained; escape DC 13
description: Thick tarred cord with doubled knots. Built for big game.
rules: As a Net, but escape DC 13 Str (Athletics). Net has AC 12, 10 HP. Huge creatures don't succeed automatically, they make the save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) with Advantage.

name: Weighted Net
useText: Throw 10 ft, Dex save or Restrained and Prone
description: Lead weights sewn into the edges. It drops whatever it hits.
rules: As a Net, but range 10 ft. On a failed save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) a Medium or smaller target is also knocked Prone. Escape DC 11 Str (Athletics). Net has AC 10, 5 HP.

name: Silk Fowler's Net
useText: Throw 30 ft, Dex save or Restrained; fliers fall
description: A fine silk net built for birds and fliers. Packs very small.
rules: As a Net, but range 30 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) or Restrained. A flying creature Restrained by it falls. Escape DC 10 Str (Athletics). Net has AC 10, 3 HP.

name: Gambeson
useText: AC 11 + Dex; Adv on cold exposure saves
description: A thick quilted coat. Warm and quiet, but bulky.
rules: Light armor. AC 11 + Dex. No Disadvantage on Stealth. Advantage on Con saves against Extreme Cold.

name: Oilskin Cloak
useText: Rain: no penalty to Con saves
description: Waxed canvas with a deep hood. You and your pack stay dry.
rules: Drizzle and Rain don't lower your Con saves. Your pack stays dry.

name: Winter Furs
useText: Adv on cold exposure saves; Disadv vs heat
description: Layers of wolf and bear fur.
rules: Advantage on saves against nonmagical Extreme Cold. Disadvantage on saves against Extreme Heat.

name: Desert Wrap
useText: Adv on heat exposure saves
description: Light linen layers and a face veil.
rules: Advantage on saves against Extreme Heat. Protects eyes and lungs from sand and dust.

name: Ghillie Cloak
useText: Chosen terrain: Adv to Hide if you didn't move
description: Covered in strips of cloth, leaves and grass.
rules: Choose a terrain (forest, grassland, rock, swamp). In that terrain, Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to Hide if you haven't moved this turn. 1 hour to change terrain.

name: Shadowweave Cloak
useText: Adv on Stealth in Darkness
description: Charcoal-grey, dull and very quiet.
rules: Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks in Dim Light or Darkness.

name: Smuggler's Coat
useText: 3 hidden pockets for ½-slot items, DC 15 to find
description: A plain coat with three hidden pockets.
rules: Each pocket holds one ½-slot item (a dagger, a potion, a lockpick). Pocketed items don't use pack slots. DC 15 Int (Investigation) to find them on a search.

name: Reversible Outfit
useText: Swap looks in 1 min; Adv on Deception in role
description: Two complete looks in one.
rules: Swap between the two outfits in 1 minute. Advantage on Cha (Deception) checks to pass as the outfit's role.

name: Shield Strap
useText: Don or doff a shield
description: A leather back-strap for a shield.
rules: Don or doff your shield as a Bonus Action instead of a Utilize action.

name: Potion Bandolier
useText: 6 quick spaces for potions, flasks, bombs
description: A leather belt with six padded loops.
rules: Counts as a quick-access bag with 6 spaces for ½-slot items (potions, flasks, bombs). Taking one out doesn't use your free object interaction.

name: Climbing Harness
useText: Roped in: a fall stops after 10 ft, no damage
description: Leather straps and an iron ring.
rules: While roped to an anchor, a fall stops after 10 ft and deals no damage.

name: Grip Gloves
useText: Rain: no Disadv on climbing; no rope burn
description: Rough leather gloves with sanded palms.
rules: Rain doesn't give you Disadvantage on climbing. No damage from rope burn.

name: Rope Ladder (25 ft)
useText: No climb check; Utilize action to anchor
description: Rope with wooden rungs and two hooks.
rules: Climbing it needs no check. Utilize action to anchor.

name: Bedroll (lightweight)
useText: Counts as a bedroll
description: Thin wool roll with a waxed underside.
rules: Works as a Bedroll, for half the slots.

name: Net Hammock
useText: Sleep off the ground; needs two anchors
description: A rope hammock with a mosquito net.
rules: Sleep off the ground. Ignore insects and wet ground when resting. Needs two anchors.

name: Two-Person Tent (quick-pitch)
useText: Tent; set up in 1 min
description: Two-person tent with folding poles.
rules: Counts as a tent (rest DC −5). Set up in 1 minute instead of 10.

name: Two-Person Tent (camouflage)
useText: Tent; DC 15 Perception to spot beyond 60 ft
description: Two-person tent dyed in earth and leaf tones.
rules: Counts as a tent (rest DC −5). DC 15 Wis (Perception) to spot from more than 60 ft away.

name: Explorer's Pavilion
useText: Sleeps 4; tent; wind doesn't raise the rest DC
description: A heavy canvas tent with guy lines and storm flaps.
rules: Sleeps 4. Counts as a tent. Wind doesn't raise the rest DC, except a Storm.

name: Sailcloth Tarp
useText: Shelter for 6 (−5 rest DC); no help in Gust or Storm
description: A big square of oiled canvas.
rules: Rain shelter for up to 6 people: rest DC −5. No bonus in Gust or Storm, the wind tears it loose. Also works as a ground sheet or stretcher.

name: Leather Armour
useText: AC 11 + Dex
description: Boiled and stiffened leather.
rules: Light armor. AC 11 + Dex.

name: Studded Leather Armour
useText: AC 12 + Dex
description: Tough leather reinforced with rivets.
rules: Light armor. AC 12 + Dex.

name: Chain Shirt
useText: AC 13 + Dex (max 2)
description: Interlocking rings worn under clothes.
rules: Medium armor. AC 13 + Dex (max 2).

name: Scale Mail
useText: AC 14 + Dex (max 2); Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth)
description: A coat of overlapping metal scales.
rules: Medium armor. AC 14 + Dex (max 2). Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth).

name: Breastplate
useText: AC 14 + Dex (max 2)
description: A fitted metal chest piece over leather.
rules: Medium armor. AC 14 + Dex (max 2).

name: Half Plate Armour
useText: AC 15 + Dex (max 2); Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth)
description: Plates over most of the body.
rules: Medium armor. AC 15 + Dex (max 2). Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth).

name: Chain Mail
useText: AC 16; Str 13; Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth)
description: Interlocking rings over a quilted layer.
rules: Heavy armor. AC 16. Str 13. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth). A creature without the Str score has its Speed reduced by 10 ft.

name: Splint Armour
useText: AC 17; Str 15; Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth)
description: Vertical metal strips riveted to leather.
rules: Heavy armor. AC 17. Str 15. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth). A creature without the Str score has its Speed reduced by 10 ft.

name: Plate Armour
useText: AC 18; Str 15; Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth)
description: Interlocking plates covering the whole body.
rules: Heavy armor. AC 18. Str 15. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth). A creature without the Str score has its Speed reduced by 10 ft.

name: Brigandine
useText: AC 14 + Dex (max 2); quiet
description: Steel plates riveted inside a leather coat. Quiet and sturdy, but heavy.
rules: Medium armor. AC 14 + Dex (max 2). No Disadvantage on Stealth. 5 minutes to don, 1 minute to doff.

name: Reinforced Fitting (upgrade)
useText: Medium armor: Str instead of Dex for AC (max 2)
description: Extra straps and plates so the armor rests on strength, not agility.
rules: Fitted to one medium armor. Add your Str modifier instead of your Dex modifier to its AC (max 2). The armor takes 1 more slot.

name: Steel Gorget (addon)
useText: A crit becomes a normal hit, 1/Long Rest
description: A plate collar that guards the throat.
rules: Worn with Medium or Heavy armor. Reaction when you take a Critical Hit: it becomes a normal hit. Once per Long Rest.

name: Spiked Armour (addon)
useText: Grappling: 1d4 Piercing each turn
description: Short spikes riveted onto existing armor.
rules: While you grapple a creature or it grapples you, it takes 1d4 Piercing damage at the start of each of your turns. The armor gets Disadvantage on Stealth if it didn't have it already.

name: Bossed Buckler
useText: Bash 1d4 (Vex); Riposte when missed
description: A small fist shield with an iron boss. Offensive.
rules: Shield. +1 AC. Bash: a melee attack with the shield, 1d4 + Str Bludgeoning, Mastery: Vex. Riposte: when a melee attack against you misses, Reaction: make an Opportunity Attack against the attacker.

name: Strapped Buckler
useText: Block: Reaction, +1 AC vs one attack
description: A small shield strapped to the forearm. Defensive.
rules: Shield. +1 AC. Strapped: the hand can still hold a focus, torch or potion, but not a weapon. Block: when a creature attacks you, Reaction: +1 AC against that attack.

name: Spiked Shield
useText: Bash 1d6 (Push); Riposte when missed
description: A shield with a heavy iron spike in the boss. Offensive.
rules: Shield. +2 AC. Bash: a melee attack with the shield, 1d6 + Str Bludgeoning, Mastery: Push. Riposte: when a melee attack against you misses, Reaction: make an Opportunity Attack against the attacker.

name: Kite Shield
useText: Interpose: ally within 5 ft gets +2 AC
description: A long shield that covers the body and the friend beside you. Defensive.
rules: Shield. +2 AC. Interpose: when a creature within 5 ft of you is attacked, Reaction: it gets +2 AC against that attack.

name: Spiked Tower Shield
useText: Bash 1d8 (Topple)
description: A door-sized shield with a spiked rim. Offensive, but slow.
rules: Shield. +2 AC. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth). Bash: a melee attack with the shield, 1d8 + Str Bludgeoning, Mastery: Topple.

name: Tower Shield
useText: Plant: Half Cover for you and one ally
description: A door-sized slab of oak and iron. Hard to get past. Defensive.
rules: Shield. +2 AC. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth). Wall: up to two allies within 5 ft of you get +1 AC. Cover: Bonus Action to plant it. You and one ally behind you have Half Cover against attacks from the front. Your Speed is 0 until you pick it up (Bonus Action).

name: Havel's Shield
useText: +3 AC
description: A massive slab of rock. Cheap, unwieldy and as sturdy as it gets.
rules: Shield. +3 AC. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth).

name: Shield Upgrade
useText: +1 AC, or one more property
description: A smith reworks one shield to your liking.
rules: One per shield. Pick one: +1 AC, or one property from the shield's line. Offensive line: Bash, Riposte. Defensive line: Strapped, Block, Interpose, Wall, Cover. A large offensive shield can't gain a Reaction. Havel's Shield takes +1 AC or Wall.

name: Pavise
useText: Plant: Three-Quarters Cover from one side
description: A tall archer's shield with a fold-out prop leg.
rules: Not worn. Bonus Action to set it up next to you. One Medium or smaller creature behind it has Three-Quarters Cover from one chosen direction. Bonus Action to pick it up. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) while carried.

name: Parrying Dagger
useText: Off hand: +1 AC vs melee
description: A dagger with a wide crossguard and side rings to catch blades.
rules: Dagger (1d4 Piercing, Finesse, Light, Thrown 20/60, Mastery: Nick). While you hold it in your off hand and a Finesse weapon in the other, +1 AC against melee attacks. No bonus if you use a shield.

name: Chain Net
useText: Throw 10 ft, Dex save or Restrained; hard to cut
description: Fine steel links. Blades skate off it.
rules: As a Net, but range 10 ft. Target makes a Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) or is Restrained. Escape: action, DC 12 Str (Athletics). Net has AC 15, 15 HP. Normal damage from Force or Acid, Resistance to Slashing, Immunity to all other damage.

name: Bolas
useText: Throw 30 ft, Dex save or Speed 0
description: Three weighted cords that wrap around legs.
rules: Replace one attack of the Attack action. Target within 30 ft makes a Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus). On a fail, a Large or smaller creature with legs has Speed 0 until it or a creature within 5 ft uses an action to free it (DC 12 Str check). Not Restrained. Huge or larger succeed automatically.

name: Throwing Knives
useText: Throw 15/30 ft, 1d4 Piercing
description: Six cheap knives in a chest strap.
rules: Simple weapon: 1d4 Piercing, Finesse, Light, Thrown 15/30, Mastery: Vex. With a free hand, throw one as a Bonus Action. Don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the Bonus Action throw. Uses = knives left.

name: Broadhead Arrows
useText: +1 damage; normal range halved
description: Wide cutting heads. Brutal at short range.
rules: +1 damage. Normal range of the bow is halved, long range stays the same. Also available as bolts. Uses = arrows left.

name: Whistling Arrows
useText: Signal shot, heard 600 ft
description: Carved bone heads that scream in flight.
rules: Deals no damage. Audible up to 600 ft. Good for signals and distractions. Uses = arrows left.

name: Balanced Weapon (upgrade)
useText: +1 to hit with this weapon
description: Rebalanced and fitted by a master. Not magic, just very good.
rules: +1 to attack rolls with this weapon. Nonmagical. Doesn't stack with magic bonuses.

name: Serrated Edge (upgrade)
useText: Crit: roll one more weapon die
description: Saw-toothed edge ground into a Slashing or Piercing blade.
rules: When you score a Critical Hit with this weapon, roll one additional weapon damage die.

name: Hooked Polearm (upgrade)
useText: Hit (1/turn): Str save or pulled 5 ft
description: A back hook added to a Glaive, Halberd or Pike.
rules: Once per turn when you hit a Large or smaller creature, it makes a Str save (DC 8 + your Str mod + Proficiency Bonus) or is pulled 5 ft toward you. Replaces the push of the Pike's Push mastery if you use both.

name: Silver Paste
useText: Coat a weapon or 10 ammo: silvered for 1 h
description: A small pot of silver paste for blades or arrowheads.
rules: Utilize action to coat one weapon or 10 pieces of ammunition. Counts as silvered for 1 hour.

name: Focus Bracer
useText: Your focus works while that hand holds a weapon
description: A leather bracer with a mount for a wand, crystal or holy symbol.
rules: An arcane focus, druidic focus or holy symbol fixed to the bracer counts as held in that hand, even while the hand holds a weapon or shield. Somatic components still need a free hand.

name: Healing Draught
useText: Drink or give: 1d4 + 2 HP
description: A small vial of cloudy red liquid. Cheap, but it works.
rules: Bonus Action to drink or give. Regain 1d4 + 2 HP.

name: Potion of Healing
useText: Drink or give: 2d4 + 2 HP
description: The standard. Red, glimmering, tastes of copper.
rules: Bonus Action to drink or give. Regain 2d4 + 2 HP.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
useText: Drink or give: 4d4 + 4 HP
description: Deep crimson and slightly warm.
rules: Bonus Action to drink or give. Regain 4d4 + 4 HP.

name: Healer's Kit
useText: Stabilize a creature at 0 HP, no check
description: Bandages, salves and splints.
rules: Utilize action: expend a use to stabilize a creature that has 0 HP, without a Wis (Medicine) check.

name: Field Bandage
useText: Stabilize a creature at 0 HP, no check
description: Ready-rolled bandages in a belt pouch.
rules: Bonus Action: expend a use to stabilize a creature within 5 ft that has 0 HP, without a Wis (Medicine) check.

name: Mending Salve
useText: Short Rest: the first Hit Die rolls max
description: Herbal paste in a tin. Smells like pine.
rules: Apply at the start of a Short Rest. The first Hit Die the creature spends counts as the maximum roll.

name: Smelling Salts
useText: Wake a creature; Stable at 0 HP gets 1 HP
description: A vial of crystals that sting the nose.
rules: Utilize action: a sleeping or Unconscious creature with at least 1 HP wakes up. A Stable creature at 0 HP regains 1 HP. Doesn't work on magical sleep.

name: Antitoxin (vial)
useText: Adv on saves vs Poisoned for 1 h
description: A clear, bitter liquid.
rules: Bonus Action to drink. Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

name: Snakebite Tonic
useText: Poisoned: save again now with Adv
description: Bitter green syrup.
rules: Bonus Action to drink. If you are Poisoned, repeat the save against that effect right away with Advantage.

name: Restful Sleep Elixir
useText: Adv on your weather rest roll
description: Lavender and valerian. One sip and you're out.
rules: Drink before a Long Rest. Advantage on your roll against the weather for that rest.

name: Darkvision Draught
useText: Darkvision 60 ft for 1 h
description: Black liquid with silver flecks. Your pupils swell.
rules: Bonus Action to drink. Darkvision 60 ft for 1 hour. If you already have it, +30 ft.

name: Fleetfoot Tincture
useText: +10 ft Speed for 10 min
description: Fizzes like sparkling cider.
rules: Bonus Action to drink. +10 ft Speed for 10 minutes.

name: Bear's Brew
useText: 2d6 + 2 temp HP; Adv on Str checks 1 min
description: Thick brown ale that smells of wet fur.
rules: Bonus Action to drink. Gain 2d6 + 2 Temporary HP and Advantage on Str checks for 1 minute.

name: Liquid Courage
useText: Adv vs Frightened 1 h; Disadv on Int checks
description: Strong spirits with a dash of something alchemical.
rules: Bonus Action to drink. Advantage on saves against Frightened for 1 hour. Disadvantage on Int checks for the same time.

name: Gillweed Gum
useText: Breathe underwater 10 min; no Verbal spells
description: A chewy green wad that tastes of seawater.
rules: Bonus Action to start chewing. Breathe underwater for 10 minutes. You can't speak clearly, so spells with a Verbal component fail.

name: Fireproof Gel
useText: Fire Resistance for 1 min
description: Cold blue goo that you smear on skin.
rules: Utilize action to apply. Resistance to Fire damage for 1 minute.

name: Flame Oil
useText: Coat a weapon: +1d4 Fire for 1 min
description: A flask of oil that ignites when it touches steel.
rules: Utilize action to coat one weapon. For 1 minute it deals +1d4 Fire damage on a hit and sheds Dim Light 10 ft.

name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
useText: Throw 20 ft, Dex save or 1d4 Fire and Burning
description: Sticky liquid that ignites in air.
rules: Utilize action, throw at a creature within 20 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus). Fail: 1d4 Fire damage and it starts Burning.

name: Sticky Alchemist's Fire
useText: Throw 20 ft, Dex save or 1d6 Fire and Burning
description: Alchemist's fire thickened with pine resin.
rules: Utilize action, throw at a creature within 20 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus). Fail: 1d6 Fire damage and it starts Burning (1d4 Fire at the start of each of its turns). Ending it takes an action and a DC 12 Dex check, dropping Prone alone doesn't work.

name: Acid (vial)
useText: Throw 20 ft, Dex save or 2d6 Acid
description: A glass vial of burning acid.
rules: Utilize action, throw at a creature within 20 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus). Fail: 2d6 Acid damage.

name: Corrosive Acid
useText: As Acid; metal armor −1 AC
description: Green acid that eats through metal.
rules: Utilize action, throw at a creature within 20 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus). Fail: 2d6 Acid damage, and nonmagical metal armor it wears loses 1 AC until repaired (max −2). Success: half damage, no AC loss.

name: Tanglefoot Bag
useText: Throw 20 ft, Dex save or Restrained 1 min
description: A leather bag of sticky alchemical glue.
rules: Utilize action, throw at a Large or smaller creature within 20 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) or Restrained for 1 minute. Escape: action, DC 12 Str (Athletics). On a success, Speed halved until the end of its next turn.

name: Thunderstone
useText: Throw 30 ft: Con save or 1d6 Thunder and Deafened
description: A grey stone that hums when shaken.
rules: Utilize action, throw up to 30 ft. Creatures within 10 ft of impact make a DC 12 Con save or take 1d6 Thunder damage and are Deafened for 1 minute. Audible 300 ft.

name: Flash Powder
useText: Throw 20 ft: Con save or Blinded 1 turn
description: Magnesium and sulfur in a paper twist.
rules: Utilize action, throw up to 20 ft. Creatures within 5 ft of impact make a DC 12 Con save or are Blinded until the end of their next turn.

name: Holy Water (flask)
useText: Throw 20 ft, Dex save or 2d8 Radiant (Fiend/Undead)
description: Blessed water in a sealed glass flask.
rules: Utilize action, throw at a creature within 20 ft. Dex save (DC 8 + your Dex mod + Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Radiant damage if it's a Fiend or Undead.

name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
useText: Cover 5 ft square: Dex save or 1 Piercing, Speed 0
description: A bag of iron spikes.
rules: Utilize action: expend a use to cover a 5 ft square within 5 ft of you. A creature entering it makes a DC 15 Dex save or takes 1 Piercing damage and has Speed 0 until the start of its next turn.

name: Barbed Caltrops
useText: Cover 5 ft square: Dex save or 1d4, Speed 0
description: Blackened iron caltrops with hooked points.
rules: Utilize action: expend a use to cover a 5 ft square within 5 ft of you. A creature entering it makes a DC 15 Dex save or takes 1d4 Piercing damage and has Speed 0 until the start of its next turn. DC 15 Wis (Perception) to spot.

name: Hunting Trap
useText: Set trap: Dex save or 1d4 and Speed 0
description: A spring-loaded steel trap.
rules: Utilize action to set. A creature stepping on it makes a DC 13 Dex save or takes 1d4 Piercing damage and has Speed 0 until it escapes. Escape: action, DC 13 Str (Athletics), 1 Piercing damage per failed check.

name: Hunting Trap (folding)
useText: Set trap: Dex save or 1d4 and Speed 0
description: A hinged steel trap that packs flat.
rules: As a Hunting Trap, but set as a Bonus Action instead of a Utilize action.

name: Toothed Bear Trap
useText: Set trap: Dex save or 1d10 and Speed 0; Adv vs it
description: A massive spring trap for bears and worse.
rules: Utilize action to set. DC 14 Dex save or 1d10 Piercing and Speed 0 until it escapes. Escape: action, DC 15 Str (Athletics), 1d4 Piercing per failed check. Attacks against the trapped creature have Advantage.

name: Tripwire Bell Kit
useText: 10 min: 60 ft alarm perimeter
description: Thin wire, stakes and a dozen tiny bells.
rules: 10 minutes to set a perimeter up to 60 ft. Anyone crossing rings the bells unless they spot it (DC 15 Wis (Perception)) or step carefully (DC 13 Dex (Acrobatics)).

name: Grease Jar
useText: Pour or throw 20 ft: 10 ft square, Dex save or Prone
description: A clay jar of rendered fat and soap.
rules: Utilize action: expend a use to pour it or fling it up to 20 ft. Covers a 10 ft square for 10 minutes. Difficult Terrain. A creature entering or starting its turn there makes a DC 12 Dex save or falls Prone. Flammable.

name: Smoke Bomb
useText: Throw 30 ft: 10 ft cloud, Heavily Obscured
description: A wax ball packed with saltpeter and dried moss.
rules: Utilize action to throw (30 ft). Creates a 10 ft radius Heavily Obscured cloud for 1 minute. A Gust disperses it after 1 round, a Storm immediately.

name: Grappling Hook
useText: Throw 50 ft at a ledge, DC 13 to catch
description: Three iron tines on a ring.
rules: Utilize action: throw it at a railing, ledge or other catch within 50 ft. It catches on a DC 13 Dex (Acrobatics) check.

name: Grappling Hook (folding)
useText: Throw 50 ft at a ledge, DC 13 to catch
description: Three steel tines that fold into a short tube.
rules: As a Grappling Hook, for half the slots.

name: Grappling Bolt
useText: Fire a rope line up to 60 ft
description: A crossbow bolt with folding barbs and a rope eyelet.
rules: Fire from a crossbow with up to 60 ft of rope attached. Anchors in wood or packed earth. Stone needs a crack (DC 12 attack roll vs AC). Holds two climbers.

name: Hempen Rope
useText: 50 ft of rope
description: 50 ft of plain hemp rope.
rules: 50 ft. Utilize action to tie a knot. Burst with a DC 20 Str (Athletics) check.

name: Hempen Rope (knotted)
useText: Adv to climb it
description: Hemp rope knotted every foot. 50 ft.
rules: Advantage on Str (Athletics) checks to climb this rope.

name: Silk Rope (knotted)
useText: Adv to climb it
description: Silk rope with a knot every foot. 50 ft.
rules: Advantage on Str (Athletics) checks to climb this rope.

name: Pole (10-foot)
useText: Probe ahead from 10 ft away
description: A plain wooden pole.
rules: Useful for probing floors, water and suspicious chests from a distance.

name: Pole (collapsible)
useText: Packs to 2 ft; Utilize action to assemble
description: Five brass-capped sections that screw together.
rules: Works as a 10-foot pole. Utilize action to assemble or take apart.

name: Crampons
useText: Ice: no check to stay standing
description: Iron spikes strapped under the boots.
rules: You don't fall Prone when moving or Dashing on ice or slick rock. Disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) on hard floors.

name: Bedroll
useText: Sleep warm and off the cold ground
description: A wool roll for the night.
rules: A bed for one. Needed for a comfortable rest outdoors.

name: Two-Person Tent
useText: Tent: rest DC −5
description: Canvas tent for two.
rules: Shelter for two. Counts as a tent (rest DC −5). 10 minutes to set up.

name: Shovel
useText: Dig a 5 ft foxhole in 1 h
description: A sturdy spade.
rules: Dig a 5 ft trench or foxhole in 1 hour in soft ground.

name: Shovel (folding)
useText: Dig a 5 ft foxhole in 1 h
description: A short spade with a hinged handle.
rules: Dig a 5 ft trench or foxhole in 1 hour in soft ground. Improvised weapon (1d4 Bludgeoning).

name: Thieves' Tools
useText: Pick locks and disarm traps
description: Picks, a file and a small mirror.
rules: Pick locks and disarm traps with a Dex check if you are proficient.

name: Thieves' Tools (fine)
useText: +1 to Thieves' Tools checks
description: Hand-filed picks in a velvet roll.
rules: Works as Thieves' Tools. +1 to checks made with them.

name: Lockpick Wire
useText: Hidden pick; Thieves' Tools with Disadv
description: A single pick that hides in a hem or bootlace.
rules: Counts as Thieves' Tools, with Disadvantage. DC 18 Int (Investigation) to find on a search.

name: Manacles (masterwork)
useText: Escape DC 23, break DC 28
description: Heavy cuffs with a double lock.
rules: As Manacles, but escape DC 23 Dex (Sleight of Hand), break DC 28 Str (Athletics), pick DC 18.

name: Cheap Spyglass
useText: Adv on sight Perception beyond 60 ft
description: A brass tube with slightly warped glass.
rules: Objects look twice as close. Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks based on sight against things more than 60 ft away.

name: Glowcap Lamp
useText: Shake: light 15 ft for 1 h, works wet; 1/Long Rest
description: A jar of luminous fungus. No flame, no smoke.
rules: Bright Light 15 ft, Dim Light 15 ft more, for 1 hour after shaking. Works wet or underwater. Recharges after a Long Rest.

name: Signal Mirror
useText: Sunlight flash, seen 3 miles
description: Polished tin with a sighting hole.
rules: In sunlight, flash a signal visible up to 3 miles.

name: Blocks of Incense
useText: Ritual casting adds 5 min instead of 10
description: Resin blocks that burn slow and sweet.
rules: Burn one while casting a spell as a Ritual: the casting takes 5 extra minutes instead of 10.

name: Hardtack
useText: 1 use = 1 day of food; never spoils
description: Dense, dry and nearly indestructible.
rules: Each use feeds one person for a day. Two days of food in ½ slot, half the slots of rations. Doesn't spoil.

name: Hearty Stew Mix
useText: Short Rest meal: up to 5 eaters +1 per Hit Die
description: Dried beans, barley, salt pork and herbs.
rules: Cook over a fire during a Short Rest. Up to 5 creatures who eat it add +1 to each Hit Die they roll during that rest.

name: Ginger Jerky
useText: Cold weather: no Con save penalty for 8 h
description: Spicy dried meat. Warms you from the inside.
rules: After eating, cold weather doesn't lower your Con saves for 8 hours. One portion.

name: Strong Black Tea
useText: On watch: Adv on Perception 2 h; no sleep 4 h
description: A pouch of bitter leaves.
rules: A creature on watch who drinks a cup has Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks to notice threats for 2 hours. It can't fall asleep for 4 hours afterwards.
